full_prompt_en: A naturalistic oil-painted landscape looks past a rocky mountainside and a leafy tree into a deep valley beneath pale blue sky. The open sky fills the upper centre and right, with a small bank of soft white cloud close to the distant peaks. Across the middle distance, jagged blue-grey ridges overlap in progressively paler layers, while a forested slope descends into the valley below. On the far left, a steep brown rock wall rises beyond the top edge, its rough surface broken by cracks, dark ledges and scattered small shrubs. A single rounded green tree grows outward from this wall near the upper-left centre, its trunk partly obscured and its foliage silhouetted against the sky. Large angular boulders step down through the left foreground, their upper faces pale ochre in the light and their lower sides deeply shaded. Across the bottom, a narrow grassy ledge slopes diagonally toward the right between stones and low plants. Dark exposed roots or weathered branches lie over the nearest rough rock, adding thin irregular lines to the heavier masses. At the right edge, a tall light-grey cliff face frames the opening, with dark green shrubs gathered around its lower base. Clear daylight from the upper left catches the boulder tops, grassy ledge and right-hand rock face, while recesses in the left wall remain dark. Fine, controlled marks distinguish stone fractures and nearby foliage; distant forest and ridges soften into cool atmospheric haze. The overall composition balances close earth-toned rock and green vegetation against receding blue-grey mountains, creating a sheltered foreground view into an expansive, quiet valley.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅写实油画风景越过岩石山坡和一棵阔叶树，望向浅蓝天空下的深谷。开阔天空占据上方中央和右侧，远处峰峦旁聚有小片柔白云层。中远景锯齿状蓝灰山脊层层交叠，越远越浅，下方林木覆盖的斜坡向谷底下降。最左侧陡峭棕色岩壁伸出画面顶边，粗糙表面由裂缝、暗岩台和零散矮灌木分隔。在左上偏中央，一棵圆拢绿树从岩壁向外生长，树干部分被遮住，树叶映在天空前。左前景大型棱角巨石逐级下降，上表面受光呈浅赭色，下部则深暗。沿底部，一条窄草坡岩台在石块和低矮植物之间斜向右方下降。最近的粗岩上横着深色外露根须或风化枝条，为厚重块面增添细而不规则的线。右侧边缘高耸浅灰岩壁框住谷口，下缘聚有深绿灌木。左上方明亮日光落在巨石顶部、草坡岩台和右侧岩面上，左壁凹处仍然深暗。细密克制笔痕区分石裂与近处枝叶，远处森林和山脊柔化进冷色空气薄霭。整体构图将近处土色岩石、绿色植被与层层退远的蓝灰群山形成平衡，让被山岩围护的前景通向开阔安静的谷地。
style_prompt_en: The oil-paint treatment uses layered atmospheric perspective, with nearby forms described by firmer edges and distant planes fading into cool haze. Dark masses at the frame edge create a strong value bracket around the lighter middle distance. Blue-grey passages dominate the far space, while muted greens and warm earth tones anchor the foreground. Light is broad and natural, catching selected raised planes and leaving recesses deeply shaded. Fine marks gather around nearer textures; broader, softer transitions carry the eye toward the horizon. The overall effect balances clear foreground structure with a quiet, softened distance.
style_prompt_zh: 油画以层叠的空气透视组织空间，近处形体边缘较清楚，远方则渐隐于冷色薄霭。画面边缘的深色块形成明暗框架，衬托较亮的中远景。蓝灰色主导远处空间，低饱和绿色与温暖土色稳住前景。光线宽阔自然，照亮部分凸起色面，同时让凹处保留深影。近处纹理由细小笔触聚集表现，较宽柔的过渡则把视线带向远方。整体效果在明确的前景结构与安静柔化的远景之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A sunlit grassy ledge and lone leafy tree frame a distant jagged mountain valley
theme_zh: 受光草坡岩台与一棵阔叶树框出远处锯齿状山谷
name: 高远薄雾山水油画
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
